'''Dasar Zorm''' was a notorious [[Racketeering|racketeer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Namore]] at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="HR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dasar Zorm appeared in "[[Live And In (Bleeding) Color&hellip;|Live And In (Bleeding) Color...]]," a short companion narrative included in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HR" />
